youtube.title: Glenn Miller: The Bandleader Who Vanished Over the English Channel (Full Case File)
youtube.description:
On 15 December 1944, Major Glenn Miller, the most famous bandleader in the world, took off from RAF Twinwood Farm near Bedford in a single-engine UC-64 Norseman bound for liberated Paris, with Lt. Col. Norman Baessell and pilot Flight Officer John Morgan. The plane disappeared over the English Channel and no wreckage was ever found. This documentary covers Miller's rise (the Miller Sound, Moonlight Serenade, the first gold record), his decision to join the Army at 38, the last flight, why nobody noticed for days, the theories (from bombs jettisoned by RAF Lancasters to a secret death in Paris), and what researcher Dennis Spragg's 2017 study suggests most likely happened.

📂 Case File #029: The Glenn Miller Mystery — full documentary
